title: WWE Superstar Alexa Bliss Says She Been Healthy Since Before Elimination Chamber PPV
htmlContent:
Bliss has been absent from the action, appearing last time in the 2022 Elimination Chamber PPV. Sadly, it was her first game since September 2021, when she lost to Charlotte Flair in Extreme Rules. After the match, Charlotte tore Bliss's Lilly doll, which caused the doll to collapse.

While backstage was showing Bliss on her "Journey back to RAW", she finally made it back to the Elimination Chamber and left after Bianca Belair's win. Fans wonder when Alexa Bliss will come back permanently.

Bliss received the question directly from Twitter. She replied that her return to WWE had nothing to do with her.

Naturally, WWE leaders and leaders decide when the stars will be capable of performing. Sadly for Bliss, she is now away for a long time. Bliss's reply indicates that it is not an injury that keeps her away, and she cannot do anything to hasten her return.

In a recent interview with journalist Adam Glyn, Bliss was asked again when we might see her again in a WWE ring.

"Hopefully soon," said Bliss.

"Just waiting on the call and have been ready go since before Saudi Arabia."
